Goal
* "Everything after (the colon) is a whitespace-separated list" is not quite accurate. Please describe it consistently with the actual syntax (a colon followed by a space).

* Built-in macros table: Please move "in definition order" onto a separate line. The current table row is truncated on narrower browser windows.

* "Either list may be empty" contradicts the syntax shown, which always contains at least one target before the colon.

* There are currently no test cases that require handling of multiple targets before the colon. If rule lines are always single-target, please remove the multi-target explanation for simplicity. Otherwise, please add test cases that exercise multi-target rules.

* Please standardise the terms. Currently several similar or undefined terms are used:

  • rules, rule lines
  • actions, action lines
  • definitions
  • definition action lines

* "If no targets are requested" is unclear because the term "requested" is never mentioned elsewhere. Presumably this corresponds to nTargets = 0, but the Input section doesn't state that explicitly.

* Consider replacing the term "dependency graph" (used twice in the statement) with a direct description of the requirement (e.g. "all target dependencies are checked for cycles before building") for easier understanding.

* Timestamps ignored: Consider moving this point to the end as a note rather than including it among the core build rules.

* Formatting:
  • "targets", "prerequisites", "actions", "rules", "action lines", "comments" and "default target" in <<bold>> instead of as {{constants}}

  • ":", "TAB" and "#" as {{constants}} instead of [[variables]].
 
Input / Constraints
* Please align the variable names with those used in the stub generator.

Output
* <If a circular dependency is detected:>: Please format ">" in <<bold>>.

* Please format "A single line", "One line per action executed" and "Final line" in <<bold>> and remove the surrounding "<" and ">".

* Please format "[Circular dependencies detected]" and "[Build complete]" as {{constants}}.

* A single line already implies that only one line should be output, so the phrase "— no action lines (etc.) are output" is unnecessary. Please remove it for clarity.

Constraints
* Please add a constraint for every input in the same order as it appears in the Input section:

  • integer input: lower and upper bounds.

  • string input: minimum and maximum lengths.

* Please state targets and prerequisite names do not contain spaces or {{#}} characters.

* Please use bounds that better reflect the actual test cases, e.g. 10 instead of 1000.

Stub generator
* Please change Line 2 to:
loopline nTargets target:word(10)

* Please replace 1024 and the above 10 with the upper bounds used in the Constraints section.

Cases
* Please remove trailing newlines from both the inputs and the outputs of all the cases.

* N is 0 in most cases.

* I'll review the cases in more detail once the statement is clearer.

Thanks.

Thanks much for feedback.  Addressing now.

I'm also thinking of adding a list of preexisting target names with timestamp values to the inputs, so that timestamp-dependent builds are part of the problem, which would make it more interesting than a standard dependency graph. Do you think that's a bad idea?

Thanks. I think that could work, but a few things come to mind.

The current (unrevised) Goal section is already around 4.2k characters, with a 5k limit. So, the feasibility of adding timestamps will depend on how much additional explanation is needed.

From a puzzle-design perspective, differentiating it from existing dependency-graph-style puzzles is not a bad idea, given that there's already a somewhat similar puzzle involving library dependencies, cycle detection, and lexicographic tie-breaking/reordering (see https://www.codingame.com/training/easy/library-dependencies ).

That said, it depends on the complexity level you're aiming for. Adding timestamps could make the puzzle more interesting and make the puzzle a closer simulation of make-style build behaviour, but it'd also move the puzzle away from being a relatively straightforward graph problem and increase both implementation and statement complexity.
OK, I think I have addressed most of your concerns, and I have added timestamps as well, and improved the test cases. Let me know what you think and if I should open it for approval...
Thanks for the update. I'll review the contribution as soon as I can, and should be able to get back to you by next Tuesday at the latest.

Goal
* First paragraph: The phrase "build outdated or missing target files" sounds odd. Consider rewording it to indicate that a target file is (re)built if it is outdated or missing, or simply omit "outdated or missing".

* Whitespace handling is described in both the Whitespace and Actions sections. Consider avoiding the duplication:

  • Replace "Except for the special case of a TAB at the start of a line" with "After using {{TAB}}s to identify actions (see below), {{TAB}}s".

  • Replace "The TAB and any additional leading/trailing whitespace is removed, and the line is interpreted as" with "Applying the whitespace rules above to the line yields".

* Please correct the typo: he resulting => the resulting.

* Consider avoiding the new term "default target" and replacing "the default target … is used" with "the first <<target>> in the first <<rule>> of the Makefile is treated as the <<required target>>".

* In the example, consider revising the input order to better illustrate:

  • the lexicographically smaller name main.o is built first

  • the prerequisites in their given rule order, not the order they were built

Input
* Please change the first "One Line" to "Line 1", and the other two occurrences to "Next line".

* Please replace "If cmdArgs is empty, the default target is the required target" with "or an empty line", since the behaviour is already explained in the Goal section (if you adopt the suggestion above).

* "Syntax rules are described above" may be removed.

Output
* Please format "A single line" in <<bold>>.

* Please format "One line per action executed" in <<bold>> and remove the surrounding "<" and ">".

* Please format "Final line" in <<bold>>.

* Please format "[Circular dependencies detected]" and "[Build complete]" as {{constants}} instead of using ```monospace``` formatting.

Constraints
* Please specify lower bounds for nLines, nFiles, len(cmdArgs) and len(makefileLine).

* Please change "len" to "length" (3 times).

* Please change 10^9 to 1000.

* Please change 200 to 100 (twice).

* Please reorder the first six constraints to match the order of items in the Input section.

* Please reorder the final six constraints so that related ones (e.g. all constraints related to actions) are grouped together as much as possible.

Stub generator
* Line 2: Please change 200 to 20.

* Line 3 & Line 5: Please change 200 to 100.

Cases
* Please remove trailing newlines from both the inputs and the outputs of all cases.

* nFiles = 0 in 4 tests and no validators. Please modify the cases so that there are equal numbers of tests and validators with nFiles = 0.

* Targets that share the same prerequisites seem to appear in validators only, but not in any tests.

* Please split the final pair of test and validator into two pairs, as they cover entirely different scenarios.

* Please ensure that every specification in the Goal section is covered by at least one test and at least one validator.

Thanks.
All feedback sounds reasonable, will address. Thanks for the time you put in reviewing…
